title: Rain
description: A city skyline at dusk behind a rainy window, drawn live: layered sunset sky, low sun, three depths of towers with lit windows and water tanks on the roofs. Drops bead, merge and run down the glass, each holding a tiny upside-down view of the city; drag across the fogged pane to wipe a clear streak.
intent: One physical surface finished to the edge: real water on real glass, where every drop is a lens and your finger is the only way to see out.
